html:
If you live in ZIP 29650 and you are looking for house cleaning in Greer, SC, the most useful thing we can tell you is what happens between sending a message and seeing a clean kitchen. People often hesitate because they do not know the steps. Here they are, in the order they happen, from a team that lives and works in Greer.

Step 1: you reach out

You can fill in the form on the Greer house cleaning page, call (864) 399-5168 or text (864) 666-8520. Tell us your street or neighborhood, the number of bedrooms and bathrooms, whether you have pets, and the days you prefer. You do not need to know what service you want. If you are unsure about regular versus deeper cleaning, we sort that out together.

Step 2: the free in-home estimate

This is where we differ from companies that quote by text. Someone from the team comes to the house, walks through every room and asks what bothers you most. We check the floors, count the bathrooms, look at the kitchen and note anything unusual, like a sunroom with lots of glass or a dog that sheds on the stairs. The visit is free and has no commitment. You get an exact price and expected time before you decide, and we do not give dollar amounts by phone or photo, since they would be guesses.

Step 3: your schedule

If you like the plan, we pick a start date. Greer is our home base, so 29650 is close to the team and we can often fit visits in quickly. Ask about openings this week, and we will tell you straight what is possible. Weekly, biweekly and monthly schedules are all available, and we keep the same team where we can so they learn your house.

Step 4: the first visit

The first clean is usually deeper than the visits that follow, because the team is bringing the home to a level it can maintain. They work room by room, and in the bathrooms and kitchen they use the Brazilian detail-first method: hand-wiping instead of a quick spray and pass, with attention to baseboards, door frames, light switches and handles.

What a regular visit covers

  • Kitchen counters, sink and stovetop cleaned and sanitized, with appliance fronts and handles wiped
  • Bathrooms: toilet, shower, tub, mirrors and chrome
  • Floors vacuumed and mopped by hand
  • Surfaces, shelves and furniture dusted
  • Beds made and trash emptied
  • Baseboards and door frames touched up on a rotation
  • Light switches and high-touch spots wiped

You will not see a single price for everyone, and that is on purpose. The price comes after the free estimate and depends on:

Greer homes and what they need

Greer covers a lot of ground. There are historic homes near Downtown Greer and Trade Street, with older floors and trim, and newer neighborhoods near GSP Airport and the BMW plant, with open floor plans and large kitchens. The city sits across Greenville and Spartanburg counties along I-85, SC-14, SC-101 and US-29, and ZIP codes 29650, 29651 and 29652 all fall within it. An older home usually needs more time on trim and window sills. A newer open plan has more floor to cover and often more glass. We tune the scope to the house instead of using one formula.

Who tends to book

Busy families and dual-income households make up much of our regular list. Pet owners fighting hair and dander book often, and so do seniors who want help keeping the home safe and clean, and homeowners who like a guest-ready house every week. If one of those is you, we have a schedule that likely fits.

What to do before the team arrives

A little preparation makes the first visit count. You do not need to scrub anything first, since that is our job, but these steps help the time go into cleaning.

  1. Clear the kitchen counters and the bathroom surfaces of loose items, so we can wipe under them.
  2. Pick up toys, laundry and papers from the floors.
  3. Tell us about anything fragile, any rooms you want skipped and where the pets will be.
  4. Leave a note about the spots that bother you most. Many people say the shower glass or the kitchen backsplash, and we make a point of starting there.

On the day, the team will not rearrange your things. Everything goes back where it was, and the bed is made at the end of the visit. If you spot something afterwards that was not what you expected, tell us, and we will come back to fix it.
